title: The Hidden Space of Safety: Understanding Preference-Tuned LLMs in Multilingual context

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing distributional shifts in the embedding space of LLMs across different languages (English, Hindi, Chinese, German) using a balanced multilingual toxicity corpus and parallel text detoxification datasets. The methodology uses Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Bhattacharyya Distance, Silhouette Scores, and variance metrics to quantify the separation between harmful and harmless representation clusters before and after safety alignment.
